# AllTheThings
Do you find yourself completing old content just so that you can get literally everything for your Collections? Say no more! ALL THE THINGS will help you with your endeavor by giving you the ability to track your completion for everything.

## Features
- Supports tracking of Achievements, Quests, Appearances, Mounts, Pets, Toys, Titles, Decor, and much more.
- Primary Collections Window is movable and resizable.
- Auto Minilist
- Datatext Support
- Multiple Database modules to keep the addon from having to access the Blizzard API.
- Filters to allow you to customize the addon to your preferences.
- Extra tooltip information (Models, Icons, Descriptions, etc.).
- Fanfare music when you learn anything new.

## Release Schedule
There are two release types: alpha builds and official releases.
- Alpha Build
    - Scheduled builds are temporarily paused. Manual builds are still available in GitHub Actions.
- Official Release
    - Scheduled every Sunday.
    - Expected to be updated on the first day of any major WoW update, with frequent releases in the following days.

The git version is not a release, but it is still supported.

## Why do I need this addon?
- Ability to see what items you are missing from your collection in a more presentable way than Blizzard's UI.
- The UI has information on quests, vendors, rares, dungeons and raids, world events, and more.

## Problem? Suggestion?
If you just updated and are getting tons of errors, completely close your game and then reopen it. Updating addons while the game is running can cause problems!

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/allthethings)

## Contributors
Thank you to the contributors for the work they do and the users who have submitted suggestions and bugs in Discord or on the forums! View and follow [our contributors here](https://github.com/ATTWoWAddon/AllTheThings/graphs/contributors)!

## Special Thanks

- Gello -- Helped us to get NPC localization.
- Breanni -- Allowing us to use notes from [WarcraftPets website](https://www.warcraftpets.com/).
- DeadSerious -- Winner of our Logo Contest, Primary Artist for all Branding for ATT & Crieve's Twitch channel.

- Kawna -- Does artwork to help out with the project.
- Nightswifty -- Added ATT information to a [wowhead guide](https://www.wowhead.com/transmogrification-overview-frequently-asked-questions).

## Other Recommended Addons

- [Can I Mog It?](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/can-i-mog-it) -- Great addon that adds tooltip info for appearances and overlays for vendors, bags, etc.
- [Rematch](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rematch) -- The best pet journal replacement there is. Many many features.
- [LastSeen](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/lastseen) -- Addon that helps track the last time you saw an item. (this is helpful for collectors that have collector friends... Or a Discord. :D)

## Support Us
You can donate to our [Patreon here](https://www.patreon.com/allthethings)!

## [5.4.18](https://github.com/ATTWoWAddon/AllTheThings/tree/5.4.18) (2026-11-24)

- [DB] Add the Old Chest hidden quest trigger.  
    * Quest 95600 completes when opening the Old Chest in Feralas after The  
      Old Key (95599); added as a hidden quest trigger and removed from the  
      Missing DB.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
- [Locale] Add strings for new Windows and skip options.  
    * SKIP\_SEEN\_CUTSCENES\_ONLY\_CHECKBOX(\_TOOLTIP) for the seen-only movie  
      option, and eight WINDOWS\_* strings for the Windows page's group  
      headings, Flat and In Main List toggles and reload note.  
    * English only, with TODO lines for the other locales; the settings  
      pages now read them from L instead of hard-coded text.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
- [Settings] Skip only movies you've already seen.  
    * New "Only Skip Movies You've Seen" option under Automatically Skip  
      Cutscenes: each movie plays the first time the account sees it and is  
      skipped after that. Seen movie IDs are kept in  
      ATTAccountWideData.SeenMovies.  
    * In-engine cinematics have no ID, so they always play in this mode.  
    * The option is greyed out while cutscene skipping is off. Its text  
      falls back to English until the strings are added to the locales.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.

    * Brew of the Month Club (12278, 12306) checked t.altQuests[1], but their  
      altQuests only exist outside Classic, so the OnUpdate errored in  
      Wrath, Cata and Mists and blanked the main and mini lists while  
      "All Seasonal Events" was on. It now checks only the quest itself.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
- Use native quest links for Forever  
- Updated the plain quest link format for recipients that have an addon like Questie installed.  
- If you have Questie and aren't on a quest, it'll now link as a parsable Questie chat message.  
- [DB] Add the third library reward quest.  
    * Greater Friend of the Library (84394) needs 35 books and level 50 and  
      rewards Antique Bulwark, Artifact Seeker's Pendant or Museum Keeper's  
      Chain; removed them from the Missing DB.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
- [DB] Add Uhgar to Razor Hill.  
    * Uhgar  (3163) in Razor Hill, Durotar, in Forever, SoD and  
      Standard, Horde only, selling his eight common weapons.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
    Co-authored-by: milotic <al0305@hotmail.com>  
- [Windows] Disable the Pet Battles window in Forever.  
    * Forever has nothing that requires pet battling, so the Pet Battles  
      window was always empty there.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
- [DB] Link the weekly per-character quest reward for Aqir Research Satchel for visibility  
    [DB] Add maps and some HQT names for Ritual Sites  
- [Parser] Protect dailyReward/weeklyReward table inputs  
- auctions: move profession gear to its own heading, use exact search (#2774)  
    auctions: move profession gear to its own heading  
    auctions: use exact search when searching for an item  
- [Tooltip] Hook EQ Objective Tracker tooltip. (#2796)  
    - Add EQOTTooltip to HookableTooltips for EQ Objective Tracker's tooltip.  
- [MoP] Bump wago files to 5.5.4.71089  
- [Maps] Match instances by name when the ID differs.  
    * ATT keys instances by journal ID, which only sometimes equals the  
      game's instance ID (Blackrock Spire 229 does, Dire Maul 230/429 does  
      not). When no map is reported and the ID lookup finds nothing, match  
      the instance by name, so the Dire Maul Mini List works in Forever.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- [Logic] Count lower spell ranks as known in Forever.  
    * Forever now runs the pass that marks lower ranks known when a  
      higher rank is known (e.g. First Aid (Apprentice) with Journeyman).  
    * The Classic spellbook scan uses the DB rank when the client gives  
      none, so a single profession entry no longer overwrites rank 1.  
    * The counting fallback now remembers the last rank it saw.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- [Settings] Drop the InterfaceOptionsFrame fallback.  
    * The Windows page's Reload UI button hides SettingsPanel only. No  
      current client defines InterfaceOptionsFrame, and SettingsPanel exists  
      in all of them.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- [Settings] Add an option to hide the Auction tab.  
    * Retail and Forever get a "Show the Auction House Module Tab" checkbox  
      (on by default) where Classic has the auto-open option.  
    * Turning it off removes ATT's Auction House tab and module completely.  
    * Saved as Show:AuctionTab, since Retail resets Auto:AuctionList.  
    Fixes #2745  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
- [Docs] Rescan APIs after the Windows UI redesign.  
    * Record deprecated scroll templates and their history by client.  
    * Update the wrapper inventory and verify the remaining legacy calls.  
    Assisted-by: gpt-6.2-sol, gpt-6.1-sol.  
- [Settings] Redesign the Windows settings page.  
    * The Windows page is one scrollable list grouped into Main Lists,  
      Collections, Professions, Quests & Progress, Tools and Other.  
    * Each row shows the window's progress and slash command, plus Flat and  
      In Main List (IsDynamicCategory) toggles where the window supports them.  
    * Windows set their own SettingsGroup and SettingsOrder.  
    * In Main List is saved per window (Classic and Forever only) and takes  
      effect after a reload; a Reload UI button appears when it changes.  
    * The Style subpage is removed; its Flat buttons are now on the rows.  
    * Classic clients use the classic panel scrollbar on the Windows and  
      Profiles pages, which no longer overlaps the Profiles buttons.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
- [DB] Add Depth-Risen Leggings to The Drowned City.  
    * Depth-Risen Leggings (286997) drops from trash in The Drowned City;  
      removed from the Missing DB.  
    Assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- [DB] Rework Forever profession trainers and vendors.  
    * Each profession lists its trainer recipes under headers named after  
      its rank or specialization spell, e.g. "Cooking (Apprentice)".  
    * Each tier header has a symselector; crafting trainers select only the  
      tier of the highest rank they teach, so popouts show who teaches it.  
    * Added 260 profession, specialization and poison trainers from  
      Wowhead Forever's "taught by" lists, with coords from their NPC pages.  
    * Cooking, First Aid, Fishing, Herbalism, Mining, Skinning and Poisons  
      no longer use the shared CLASSIC\_* lists, so their ranks lose the  
      retail 8.0.1/3.0.2 removal markers.  
    * Specialization tiers keep their specialization requireSkill.  
    * New automatic header type HEADERS.SpellWithRank ("sr") with a  
      GetSpellSubtext API wrapper adds the rank text to a spell's name.  
    * The Merchant's Favor recipe lists live on their Trade Logistics  
      vendors instead of shared tables.  
    * Common enchanting recipes moved to Common Vendor Items under an  
      Enchanting symselector header; all ten Enchanting Supplies vendors
